results.q: Hey what happened at the Rayban event?
results.trace: Incidents · Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 Launc… (3) INC-2026-0612 INC-2026-0613 INC-2026-0625 11.9 s · 3 steps
results.answer:
Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 Launch — Harbor Reveal from Pier 26 on June 29 — had one on-air hit with a knock-on, plus one catch in test. All 3 reports are closed.

1. SEV-2 — Lost primary, 38s of rebuffering — INC-2026-0612
Most severe, 14 minutes into the show at 09:14 ET:

What viewers saw: rebuffering on every destination — Facebook Live, Instagram Live, meta.com — for about 38 seconds. Rebuffer peaked at 7.8% vs 0.4% baseline.
Impact: 297,000 viewers affected, 96,400 viewer-minutes. Total event 3m 41s, breached the 99.9% availability target at 99.55%.
Root cause: failing SFP on the venue access switch in the Pier 26 hut flapped the single 1 GbE municipal fiber. SRT loss went 0% → 18% in 6 seconds, and MediaLive didn't auto-failover for 29 seconds because the input-loss threshold had been raised from 2s to 10s after a rehearsal false-positive.
Fix: auto-failover to input 2 — LiveU bonded backup — which was hot and clean. Ran on LiveU for 3 min, then TOC switched back to primary during a planned VT once SRT held at 0% for 2 min. SFP replaced post-show at 09:40.

2. SEV-3 — No captions on Facebook for 6 min — INC-2026-0613
Triggered by that same failover at 09:15 ET:

What viewers saw: CEA-608 captions missing on Facebook Live for 6m 02s, ~180,000 viewers. WebVTT on meta.com was fine.
Root cause: EEG Falcon was inserting 608 only on the primary SDI path — backup LiveU path had no captions.
Fix: captions returned when we switched back to primary at 09:18, Facebook needed ~3 min to render again.

3. SEV-4 — LiveU test low throughput — INC-2026-0625
Day before, June 28: bonded test showed 14 Mbps vs 20 Mbps target. One 5G modem on old rental firmware, LTE-only. Updated on site, retest held 24 Mbps. Zero viewer impact.

Still open from the post-mortems:

Add venue switch SNMP/syslog — CRC / link flaps — to TOC wall — Network Eng D. Okafor — Open
Add caption-presence probe per destination — Streaming Eng K. Rhodes — Open

Everything else is Done — failover back to 2s, 2,000ms SRT standard for open-water, diverse-path requirement for waterfront venues, captions moved upstream of the split.

Want me to pull up either full report in Muse Live?

results.q: What was the root cause of INC-2026-0612?
results.answer:
Root cause — INC-2026-0612, Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 Launch:

A failing SFP on the venue access switch in the Pier 26 hut flapped the single 1 GbE municipal fiber circuit.

That alone shouldn't have been viewer-visible for 38s, but two settings made it worse:

SRT latency was 1,200 ms — sized for land, not open-water. It couldn't recover bursts longer than the buffer. Standard is now 2,000 ms+ for waterfront / long-haul.
MediaLive auto-failover was at a 10s input-loss threshold — raised from 2s after a false failover in rehearsal, without follow-up review. It took 29s to declare input lost.

What happened

June 29, 2026, ~09:14 ET — 14 minutes into the Harbor Reveal live on Facebook Live, Instagram Live, and meta.com/rayban:

SRT primary loss 0% → 18% in 6s, RTT 22 → 310 ms
MediaLive didn't fail over to LiveU backup (input 2) until 09:15:10
Viewers saw rebuffering for ~38s. Ran on LiveU for 3 min, switched back to primary at 09:18:13 during a VT once SRT held at 0% for 2 min. SFP replaced post-show at 09:40.

Impact — SEV-2, Closed:

297,000 viewers affected, 96,400 viewer-minutes
Rebuffer peak 7.8% vs 0.4% baseline
Total duration 3m 41s, 38s viewer-visible
Breached 99.9% availability target for the event — hit 99.55%

Contributing:

Single fiber into the hut. 5 GHz microwave was comms-only, not video backup.
SFP was logging CRC errors on Gi1/0/24 from 08:40 — no one watching switch telemetry.

Fix / still open

Failover threshold back to 2s on all shows — Done — K. Rhodes
Diverse-path contribution required for waterfront/remote — Done — L. Hart
SRT 2,000 ms standard for open-water — Done — K. Rhodes
Exec comms template <3 min — Done — M. Chen
Still Open: Add venue switch SNMP/syslog (CRC, link flaps) to TOC wall — Network Eng — D. Okafor, due 2026-08-01

results.q: Why was the Charm stream too loud on Facebook?
results.trace: Incidents · loud Facebook loudness (1) INC-2026-0206 6.6 s · 3 steps
results.answer:
Double loudness processing — the Charm mix got gain twice on the way to Facebook.

What happened: Jan 24, during the Meta Charm Launch keynote from Milan. Live at 19:00, viewer complaints of "too loud" at 19:04, fixed at 19:31. About 27 min viewer-visible.

Viewer impact: SEV-3, ~140k viewers affected on Facebook Live (also Instagram Live). Walk-in music jumped ~+3 dB and clipped.

Root cause: Milan program was mixed correctly to -23 LUFS (EBU R128). But the encoder had AGC enabled with a US preset — -24 LKFS — carried over from a US show template. Facebook ingest normalization + that AGC applied a second gain stage.

Telemetry captured:

Program: -23 LUFS
Facebook return: -20.1 LUFS
True peak: +0.4 dBTP — clipping

Fix: Disabled encoder AGC, set limiter at -1 dBTP. Levels back at target.

Follow-up — both Done, none open:

Region-specific encoder audio templates (EBU vs ATSC) — N. Barrett — Done
Loudness meter on the platform return feeds — K. Rhodes — Done

Lesson from the report: no loudness meter on the return feeds from the platforms, so the team was relying on viewer comments via the social team.

Traced jitter to the shared VLAN at 14:50, moved RVON to the dedicated production VLAN with DSCP EF marking by 14:58 — clean after that.

results.q: What action items are still open from the Ray-Ban SRT incident, and who owns them?

results.answer:
From the Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 Launch — INC-2026-0612, June 29:

What happened: 14 minutes into the Harbor Reveal live, primary SRT from Pier 26 went 0% → 18% loss in 6 seconds. MediaLive didn't fail over to LiveU backup for 29 seconds because the input-loss threshold had been raised to 10s after a rehearsal false positive.

Viewer impact: ~38 seconds of rebuffering on all destinations — Facebook Live, Instagram Live, meta.com/rayban. 297k viewers affected, 96,400 viewer-minutes, rebuffer peaked at 7.8% vs 0.4% baseline. Breached 99.9% target for the event — hit 99.55%.

Root cause: Failing SFP on the Pier 26 hut access switch flapping the single 1 GbE municipal fiber. SRT at 1,200ms couldn't cover the bursts.

Fix: Auto-failover to LiveU input 2, then manual switch back to primary during a VT once SRT held at 0% for 2 min. SFP replaced post-show at 09:40.
